title: Step 2b: K-Means Clustering - Optimizing Features for 2D Visualization

cues.en: Instructor: Okay, so now, that being said, what else can we do?
cues.zh: 講師：好，說到這裡，還能做什麼呢？

cues.en: Well, all the rest, the genre, the age, the annual income, and the spending score seem totally relevant in order to identify some patterns in the data.
cues.zh: 其他特徵，包括性別、年齡、年收入與消費分數，看起來都和辨識資料中的模式相關。

cues.en: And so now from that point, I didn't expect you to do much more to solve this exercise, except of course, the final modification we'll do for that row.
cues.zh: 所以到這裡，除了最後還要修改那一行之外，我沒有預期你為了完成練習再做更多事。

cues.en: But we'll come to that later.
cues.zh: 那個稍後再說。

cues.en: However, now for the matrix of features, the columns that I want to keep in order to identify these patterns, will only be actually annual income and spending score.
cues.zh: 不過現在就特徵矩陣而言，我想保留來辨識模式的欄，實際上只有年收入與消費分數。

cues.en: And that's only for one particular reason, which is mainly for teaching purposes.
cues.zh: 原因只有一個，主要是教學上的考量。

cues.en: Well, at the end, at the end of this implementation, I indeed want to visualize with you the clusters, the clusters identified by the K-means algorithm.
cues.zh: 在這個實作結束時，我想和你一起把 K-means 演算法辨識出的群組視覺化。

cues.en: But in order to visualize them, well, we actually need a two dimensional plot, right?
cues.zh: 但要視覺化，實際上就需要二維圖，對吧？

cues.en: We need a 2D plot where on the X axis, we will have one feature, and on the Y axis, we'll have another feature.
cues.zh: 我們需要一張 2D 圖，X 軸放一個特徵，Y 軸放另一個特徵。

cues.en: And therefore, in order to visualize the clusters, we exactly need two features.
cues.zh: 所以要把群組視覺化，剛好需要兩個特徵。

cues.en: Otherwise, if we get, for example, three or four features, it'll be very hard to visualize the clusters because, well, we need one axis per feature.
cues.zh: 否則，例如有三個或四個特徵，就很難把群組畫出來，因為每個特徵都需要一個軸。

cues.en: It would be kind of possible in three dimensions, but we'll have a much nicer graph in 2D.
cues.zh: 三維還勉強可行，但二維圖會漂亮得多。

cues.en: And therefore, and once again, that's not what I expect you to do.
cues.zh: 所以再說一次，這不是我預期你在練習中就要做到的。

cues.en: We're only going to keep these two columns, the annual income and the spending score, to identify our clusters.
cues.zh: 我們只保留年收入與消費分數這兩欄，來辨識群組。

cues.en: And of course, I made this dataset so that we can indeed find some very interesting clusters for the mall, which is trying to, of course, get some insight from their customers.
cues.zh: 當然，我製作這個資料集時，就讓它能找出一些對購物中心很有意思的群組，因為購物中心想深入了解顧客。

cues.en: And therefore, now the exercise, and you can press pause on the video to complete it, is to change something here in the matrix that features X in order to select only the annual income
cues.zh: 因此，現在的練習是修改特徵矩陣 X 的這個部分，只選取年收入

cues.en: and the spending score among the features, among the variables, which we will use to identify the patterns.
cues.zh: 與消費分數這兩個特徵或變數，用來辨識模式。你可以暫停影片來完成。

cues.en: So please press pause, and I'll give you the solution in a few seconds.
cues.zh: 請先暫停，幾秒鐘後我會給你解答。

cues.en: All right, great.
cues.zh: 好，很好。

cues.en: Let's do this together now.
cues.zh: 現在一起做。

cues.en: So the exercise was to only select the annual income column and the spending score column in our matrix that features X.
cues.zh: 練習是只在特徵矩陣 X 中選取年收入欄與消費分數欄。

cues.en: So let's do this, and well, this time, since we are selecting two particular columns, well, we won't use a range to do this.
cues.zh: 來做吧。這次要選取特定兩欄，所以不用範圍來選。

cues.en: There is actually a better method.
cues.zh: 其實有更好的方法。

cues.en: We will select these columns, the indexes of these columns, into a pair of square brackets.
cues.zh: 我們把這些欄的索引放進一對方括號中，以選取這些欄。

cues.en: And that's the other way to select some columns with this iloc function.
cues.zh: 這是使用 iloc 選取欄位的另一種方式。

cues.en: It is with this pair of square brackets, inside which you can include the indexes of the columns you want to select.
cues.zh: 就是使用這對方括號，在裡面放入想選取的欄位索引。

cues.en: And so now the question is, what are these indexes?
cues.zh: 現在的問題是，這些索引是多少？

cues.en: Well, let's see.
cues.zh: 我們來看看。

cues.en: Remember that indexes in Python start from zero.
cues.zh: 記得 Python 的索引從零開始。

cues.en: So customer ID here has index zero.
cues.zh: 所以 CustomerID 的索引是 0。

cues.en: Genre has index one.
cues.zh: 性別的索引是 1。

cues.en: Age has index two.
cues.zh: 年齡的索引是 2。

cues.en: Annual income has index three.
cues.zh: 年收入的索引是 3。

cues.en: And spending score has index four.
cues.zh: 消費分數的索引是 4。

cues.en: And therefore, here in this pair of square brackets, well we just have to input three and then comma and four.
cues.zh: 因此，在這對方括號中只需要輸入 3，再加逗號和 4。

cues.en: In order to select several indexes, you have to separate them with a comma.
cues.zh: 要選取多個索引，必須用逗號分隔。

cues.en: And that's it.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: That's how you create this matrix of features selecting some specific columns with which you will learn some patterns in the data
cues.zh: 這樣就能建立特徵矩陣，選取特定欄位，用它們學習資料中的模式，

cues.en: to identify some clusters through the K-means algorithm.
cues.zh: 透過 K-means 演算法辨識群組。

cues.en: Great, so now that's done for the matrix of features.
cues.zh: 很好，特徵矩陣的部分完成了。

cues.en: But we're not done for the whole data reprocessing phase.
cues.zh: 但整個資料前處理階段還沒完成。

cues.en: And I hope you did the last necessary thing to do here in order to complete this data reprocessing phase.
cues.zh: 希望你有做完這裡最後一個必要步驟，完成資料前處理。

cues.en: So according to you, what needed to be done here for this third row of importing the dataset, for this dependent variable.
cues.zh: 你覺得匯入資料集這裡的第三行，也就是應變數這一行，應該怎麼處理？

cues.en: Well, I hope that you had the right reflex and that you very simply deleted this row.
cues.zh: 希望你有想到，直接刪除這一行。

cues.en: Because indeed, as we explained in the previous tutorial, there is no dependent variable, a priory, before we create it, for the K-means algorithm.
cues.zh: 因為正如上一堂說明的，在 K-means 演算法建立應變數之前，事先並沒有應變數。

cues.en: It will come later when we train the K-means model on the dataset.
cues.zh: 它會在稍後用資料集訓練 K-means 模型時產生。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: And speaking of the dataset, well I just like to remind that we don't have to split the dataset into a training set and a test set, because having a training set and a test set implies having a dependent variable vector.
cues.zh: 說到資料集，再提醒一下，我們不用把資料集分成訓練集和測試集，因為有訓練集與測試集，就表示有應變數向量。

cues.en: So actually here, we are all done with the data reprocessing phase.
cues.zh: 所以到這裡，資料前處理階段就全部完成了。

cues.en: Congratulations.
cues.zh: 恭喜。

cues.en: So now we're going to run these two cells to make sure everything's okay, starting with this one, importing the libraries.
cues.zh: 現在執行這兩個儲存格，確認一切正常，先從匯入函式庫開始。

cues.en: And now this one, importing the dataset, and everything seems to be all good.
cues.zh: 接著執行匯入資料集這個儲存格，看起來都沒有問題。

cues.en: We can now move on to the next step, which will be to use the elbow method to find the optimal number of clusters.
cues.zh: 現在可以進入下一步，使用手肘法找出最佳群組數量。

cues.en: Because indeed, this will be absolutely necessary when training the K-means model on the dataset.
cues.zh: 因為用資料集訓練 K-means 模型時，這是絕對必要的。

cues.en: Because when building the K-means model, we will have to specify, well, that number of clusters we wanna choose for K-means.
cues.zh: 建立 K-means 模型時，必須指定要選擇的群組數量。

cues.en: And we will want to choose, of course, well, the optimal number of clusters.
cues.zh: 當然，我們會希望選擇最佳群組數量。

cues.en: And it is the elbow method that will exactly tell us what is that optimal number.
cues.zh: 手肘法正好能告訴我們最佳數量是多少。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So whenever you're ready for that next step, to smash that elbow method, well join me in the next tutorial to implement this.
cues.zh: 準備好進入下一步、搞定手肘法時，就到下一堂和我一起實作。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你享受機器學習的樂趣。
